reviewed_boundaries: Preference is keyed by project_id and worktree, independent of slot ordering.
Only explicit chooser/add/manage-choice writes assistant_selections; renderer, polling and load paths perform no preference writes.
Modal scope epoch and current persistent scope are checked before fresh revision CAS; concurrent navigation causes refusal, not a start request.
Only assistant_selections is committed; intent, work_request, requested_slot_ids, focus, run_ids and profile assignments are not mutated by remembering.
Missing slot/profile falls back to valid assignments; a matching LIVE run is preferred only within the existing strict reusable_native_run contract.
Version1 legacy state gets empty preference defaults; records require exact keys, unique scopes, normalized absolute paths and at most1000 entries.
Existing state private file, atomic write and lock/CAS code is unchanged.
Synthetic real-native fixture retains original stop and kill-server teardown; no real account or model is invoked by authored preference regressions.
limitations: Static review and Windows AST only; full UX/backend and actual keyboard validation on a new frozen source remain required.
The raw functional results for older source snapshots are not reused as validation of this delta.
